usage: Each file is a standalone Three.js scene (CDN import). Copy the whole file or lift the scene code. All original, MIT.

scenes.title: Aurora Dome
scenes.description: An inverted sky-dome carries an original GLSL aurora — warped fbm curtains in teal and violet over a star field.

scenes.title: Borealis Ribbons
scenes.description: Five shader-driven aurora ribbons ripple across a starry night sky.

scenes.title: Bonsai Wind
scenes.description: A potted bonsai in a quiet room; gusts roll through and the leaves answer, one flutter at a time.

scenes.title: Liquid Chrome
scenes.description: A molten chrome blob rippling under a procedural studio-light environment.

scenes.title: Circuit Traces
scenes.description: Light pulses travel procedural circuit traces across a dark amber PCB.

scenes.title: Clockwork City
scenes.description: A night city where brass gears turn on every rooftop, lit windows flickering against the dark.

scenes.title: Coral Glow
scenes.description: Recursive branching corals glow in a deep teal abyss with drifting plankton.

scenes.title: Prism Study
scenes.description: A tumbling cluster of glass octahedra with inner-glow cores on a soft gallery-white stage.

scenes.title: Deep Current
scenes.description: Drifting current particles, swaying god-ray shafts, and twinkling bioluminescent plankton.

scenes.title: Caravan at Golden Hour
scenes.description: Low-poly dunes, drifting sand, and a camel caravan crossing at golden hour.

scenes.title: Helix Drift
scenes.description: Twin teal and magenta particle strands wind into a double helix with glowing rungs on near-black.

scenes.title: Ember Drift
scenes.description: Rising embers with flicker and drifting smoke over a warm ground glow.

scenes.title: Firefly Meadow
scenes.description: A dark meadow where sixty fireflies wander and pulse, each on its own clock, over swaying grass.

scenes.title: Low-Poly Islands
scenes.description: Pastel low-poly islands drift and bob at staggered heights under soft directional light.

scenes.title: The Gearworks
scenes.description: Brass gears turn at meshed ratios while steam rises through warm lamplight.

scenes.title: Glass Knot Studio
scenes.description: A transmissive glass torus knot turning slowly under studio three-point lighting on a soft gradient.

scenes.title: Glitch Stream
scenes.description: Abstract phosphor glyphs rain down through scanlines and RGB-split ghosts.

scenes.title: Greenhouse rain
scenes.description: Rain streaks the panes while seedlings sway in warm interior light.

scenes.title: Hot Air Balloons
scenes.description: Striped hot air balloons drift over patchwork fields, burners flickering, baskets swaying gently.

scenes.title: Ink Bloom
scenes.description: Monochrome ink particles bloom outward with drag and fade, like a drop of sumi ink in water.

scenes.title: Jellyfish Bloom
scenes.description: Translucent bells pulse and rise, trailing ribbons of tentacles.

scenes.title: Kaleidoscope Tunnel
scenes.description: Endless tunnel of rotating rings over a folding kaleidoscope shader field.

scenes.title: Kite Festival
scenes.description: Diamond kites dance on their strings while gusts roll across a flat blue sky.

scenes.title: Lava Lamp Room
scenes.description: A corner room at dusk with a lava lamp on the table — wax blobs rising, warm light breathing.

scenes.title: Storm Watch
scenes.description: A lighthouse beam sweeps through rain over a choppy night sea.

scenes.title: Field Lines
scenes.description: A dipole ring magnet wrapped in amber field lines and iron-filing dashes on charcoal.

scenes.title: Lunar Flyover
scenes.description: Slow camera flyover above a cratered, noise-displaced moon surface.

scenes.title: Glowing Grove
scenes.description: Bioluminescent caps light a dark forest floor; spores drift overhead.

scenes.title: Neon Horizon
scenes.description: A teal perspective grid races toward a glowing amber sun over a deep-navy horizon — tasteful synthwave, no purple-blue cliché.

scenes.title: Night Bus Rain
scenes.description: A night bus runs its route through neon rain, headlights cutting the wet street, looping past glowing signs.

scenes.title: Counting Stars
scenes.description: An open dome slit tracks the sky while the stars wheel slowly overhead.

scenes.title: Crane Flock
scenes.description: Twenty-five faceted paper cranes flapping in V formation across a dawn sky.

scenes.title: Orrery
scenes.description: A sun and five procedural planets drift through dark, majestic space.

scenes.title: Paper Boat Pond
scenes.description: Folded paper sailboats drift across a still pond, trailing expanding ripples past lily pads.

scenes.title: Paper Crane Migration
scenes.description: A flock of paper cranes crosses a starry night sky in V formation, wings beating, moon watching.

scenes.title: Lantern Festival
scenes.description: Forty glowing paper lanterns rise into a starry night sky.

scenes.title: Constellation Morph
scenes.description: 1500 additive particles drift and crossfade between sphere, torus and scattered field in deep indigo space.

scenes.title: City rain on glass
scenes.description: Droplets trickle down glass over blurred city-light bokeh.

scenes.title: Record Store Vinyl
scenes.description: Wooden crates of vinyl, a turntable with a record spinning, and a tonearm that never quite drops.

scenes.title: Ribbon Flow Field
scenes.description: Forty-eight translucent ribbons ride a sine-based pseudo-noise flow field through deep teal darkness.

scenes.title: Orbit Map
scenes.description: A stylized shader earth with three tilted orbit rings and drifting satellite dots.

scenes.title: Warp Starfield
scenes.description: Stars stream past the camera with motion-stretch trails and a cool-to-warm color shift; click to pause.

scenes.title: Downtown Local
scenes.description: Light rings rush past in an endless tunnel; the platform never moves.

scenes.title: Wireframe Terrain
scenes.description: A cyan wireframe plane ripples with layered sine waves, colored by height, over a near-black field.

scenes.title: 3D Scene Collection
scenes.description: Index and engine notes for the 40 standalone Three.js ambient scenes.

scenes.title: Tide Pool
scenes.description: Sunlight shimmers across a shallow tide pool ringed with dark rocks.

scenes.title: Topographic Map
scenes.description: A parchment heightfield with crisp ink contour lines drawn in a custom shader.

scenes.title: Typewriter Keys Rain
scenes.description: Typewriter keycaps rain onto a workbench, bounce once, rest a moment, and fall again.

scenes.title: Voxel City Night
scenes.description: Instanced voxel towers with a procedural lit-window texture drift beneath a slow aerial camera.

scenes.title: Wind Vectors
scenes.description: Hundreds of particles ride a living pseudo-noise wind field on a pale sky.

scenes.title: Raked Garden
scenes.description: Concentric raked sand rings circle weathered stones, one painted red.
